name: The Coral Castle of Deep Ocean Dreams
description: An underwater palace built from living coral that pulses with bioluminescent light, inhabited by dream-weaving sea creatures.
prompt: A magnificent underwater palace constructed from vibrant living coral that pulses with soft bioluminescent light. Schools of iridescent fish weave through ornate archways while gentle sea turtles carry glowing orbs. Jellyfish drift like chandeliers, casting prismatic reflections. Ancient stone pathways wind through gardens of kelp that sway like underwater forests. Rich turquoise and violet palette, hyperrealistic underwater fantasy, cinematic depth.
caption: Where ocean dreams are woven into coral walls and whispered by the tide... 🐚💙
